repo_notes.content: DiceLab is a personal learning project: a SceneKit + SwiftUI dice roller rebuilt from scratch, descending from the DiceRollDemo project by profburke on GitHub and a sibling local rewrite RollingDice (the ancestors are not in this repo). Direction docs — design decisions, milestone roadmap M1–M7 (including a later RealityKit port), and the tech-debt register — live in DiceLab/Documentation.docc/ and are authoritative over code comments.
repo_notes.author: laconicman

repo_notes.content: DiceLab.xcodeproj is generated by XcodeGen from project.yml and is not committed; regenerate with `xcodegen`. scripts/make-icon.swift regenerates DiceLab/Resources/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/AppIcon.png — the PNG is a build artifact, not authored content.
repo_notes.author: laconicman
